# Final sell gas affordability

Base: fc40016b637c13d2e10c90a8c5ef6f272a176b8b. Root approved R3 preflight v2 after actual-module and independent boundary tests reproduced false affordability failures. Worktree `/home/tx/projects/hoodlabs-sell-gas-fix`, branch `fix/sell-gas-affordability`. Critical implementation owner owns `src/lib/node-trading.ts`, regression tests and this contract. Root owns integration and any UI copy. Effective model/effort and usage telemetry are unknown.

Final `action === 'sell'` requires its full padded upfront gas cost at the unchanged reviewed fee cap, with zero retained future-step buffer. Its gas reserve field reports only that upfront gas cost. Sale proceeds never count toward upfront affordability. The early minimum-balance floor applies to buys; sell-side approvals still require their existing buffers after action selection. Prepare and execute distinguish an upfront shortage from a required following-step buffer shortage, reporting exact balance, required ETH and shortfall when known. Provider insufficient-funds errors without a calculated maximum retain generic actionable guidance.

Preserve Max Buy budgets, all input amounts, slippage, fee and padding policy, nonces, approval boundaries, runtime and route checks, pending balance checks, epochs, single-use reviews, exact signed transaction verification, durable hash storage and unknown-outcome recovery. No automatic progression from approvals to sales, retries or new RPC calls. Assume RPC results and persisted state are untrusted; existing validation remains in force.

Acceptance checks exercise actual prepare and execute through the ethers loopback RPC: curve and v4 Max, custom and percentage sales at exact upfront equality; feasible balances equal to or below the old floor; one-wei shortage with no signing or sending; pending balance changes; and preserved approval buffers. Run focused tests, all financial suites and typecheck. Independent verification and a fresh separate review must inspect the exact candidate before acceptance. The implementation owner cannot approve the implementation.

No production RPC writes, real signers, keys, fund movements, deployment or destructive operations. Recovery is selective reversal of this bounded source patch; the change adds no persisted state format. Test signing uses only the existing public development mnemonic against localhost. Full transient evidence is under protected `artifacts/sell-gas-diagnosis/`. Current real wallet balances and gas requirements must come from fresh read-only evidence, not historical approval maximum-cost subtraction.

Logs are `all-financial-final.log` and `typecheck-final.log` under the protected evidence directory. Final errors report the full cost plus buffer even for an upfront shortage. Approval reserve display fields retain their prior values. Independent verification and review remain required.

Root approved repair preflight v3 after a fresh review and actual ethers reproduction on c188719 showed that an execution estimate failure could reject the concurrent reads before the known pending balance reached the affordability check. A reviewed sale followed by a one-wei balance produced a raw provider error instead of its exact known shortage. Evidence: `execution-estimator-red.log`, exit 1.

Settle the pending balance concurrently with the original grouped remaining reads. If balance succeeds, check full reviewed cost plus reserve before propagating another read failure. If balance fails, propagate the original failure without fabricating a shortfall. If balance is sufficient, preserve the original grouped failure. Preserve the request count, parallel start, all successful-path checks, signing boundaries and recovery behavior. No new RPCs, retries or writes. Acceptance adds estimate and pending-simulation failures below actual gas cost, adequate-balance provider failure preservation, and unavailable-balance failure without a claimed shortfall. All failures must occur before signing or broadcast. Rerun financial checks, typecheck and independent verification and review for the new candidate.
